title: The gate refuses a change that removes or changes a public extension entry since the last ext tag without a major API version, a deprecation and a changelog entry
goal: kbext.surface_breaks(old, new) lists each public entry removed or with a changed signature between two surfaces; a break passes only when new's major version is higher than old's and old already marked the entry deprecated; while the major is 0 a higher minor counts as a higher major, as the operator's first version 0.1.0 promises no compatibility before 1.0; kbext.changelog_problems(version, text) names an API_VERSION with no kb/_self/extension-changelog.md entry; kbext.py lint --root REPO prints one line and exits 0 when REPO has no ext-v tag; kbext.py lint compares SURFACE at the newest ext-v tag, read with ast and never imported, with the working tree's and exits 1 naming each break; kbgit.py sync --push runs kbext.py lint when a changed path is under _tools/; kbext.deprecated(name, since, removed_in) warns once per process on stderr when a deprecated entry is used

clauses.clause: kbext.surface_breaks(old, new) lists each public entry removed or with a changed signature between two surfaces
a break passes only when new's major version is higher than old's and old already marked the entry deprecated
while the major is 0 a higher minor counts as a higher major, as the operator's first version 0.1.0 promises no compatibility before 1.0
kbext.changelog_problems(version, text) names an API_VERSION with no kb/_self/extension-changelog.md entry
kbext.py lint --root REPO prints one line and exits 0 when REPO has no ext-v tag
kbext.py lint compares SURFACE at the newest ext-v tag, read with ast and never imported, with the working tree's and exits 1 naming each break
kbgit.py sync --push runs kbext.py lint when a changed path is under _tools/
kbext.deprecated(name, since, removed_in) warns once per process on stderr when a deprecated entry is used

gates.question: How long must a public extension entry stay deprecated before a major API version may remove it?
gates.reason: a group then sees the stderr warning and the changelog entry on its next minor pull, before the major that removes it; longer windows slow the shared tools without a second signal

notes: Ordered after ST-qtypcthx only to serialise kbext.py; that dependency was dropped on 2026-11-08 because ST-qtypcthx waits on other sprints' claims of kbpublic.py and mon_status.py, and begin refuses two items with overlapping touches anyway.
